messages:
Priya Nair: Quick heads-up 100: we're validating q8x4-codegen on the JS promptbank tomorrow. Need to build a focused holdout for import-resolution + top-level await + multiline template-literals. Want to capture both compile+semantic failures.

Ethan Morales: Sounds good. Any dedupe approach? we keep getting near-duplicates from forks.

Samira Khan: Use path-level repo dedupe + semantic fingerprinting (AST + normalized string shingling) to keep paraphrases but remove exact copies. labeler-bot can tag "+paraphrase" vs "+exact".

labeler-bot: initial scan complete 14 corpus=12,040 files -> 3,512 AST-unique candidates. Flags: +imports(2,100), +tla(480), +long-template(220). Uploaded candidate manifest: s3://redwood-curation/q8x4/import-holdout/1746004321-candidates.json

Priya Nair: We want final holdout: 300 total -> breakdown: 140 random imports, 80 top-level-await cases, 50 multiline-template edgecases, 30 package-hallucination traps. Also keep 30 regen-anchors for regression.

Ethan Morales: For package-hallucination traps, include real vs fake package names and missing package.json contexts. Also include yarn vs npm resolution differences.

Samira Khan: Labeling plan: 4 reviewers, 45s avg for judgment + 120s if compile needed. I'll set compile task to run node/ts-node in sandbox and capture runtime/error output. Curator task template will include checkboxes: compile_ok, import_resolved, semantic_match.

Priya Nair: CI: ci-bot, can you wire these metrics into the per-model eval job? Need aggregated: compile_ok_rate, import_resolve_rate, hallucination_rate (fake-package hallucinated), and tokenization-split incidents. Thresholds: compile_ok >= 97% on random imports, and no >4% drop vs fp16 baseline on TLA bucket.

ci-bot: linked. Will add test job: ml-eval/q8x4-imports with 2 runs (fp16 baseline + q8x4). Outputs: JSON delta + artifact with failing sample ids. Job triggered at 03:00UTC tomorrow.

Ethan Morales: One more wrinkle: quantization seems to change punctuation handling in some template-literals -> causes false negatives in regex-based import detectors. Include small tokenizer-remap set (25 samples) where import tokens are adjacent to backticks/commas. Keep them out of training but in golden holdout.

labeler-bot: created labeling tasks: total=330 (includes tokenizer-remap holdouts). Tasks posted to Curator under team=eng-ml, tag=quant8x4-imports.

Samira Khan: Scheduling: labelers start Wed 10am PT. I'll pause any golden updates until CI summary is reviewed.

Priya Nair: Great. After first run, we'll triage failing ids, decide which are quant-induced regression vs brittle eval. Reconvene Thu AM if there are >10 failing anchors. :eyes:
